title: Rachana Sutra, language 1
description: A Sutra: how entities of a kind are laid out. One YAML document per file (<name>.v<N>.sutra.yaml).

version.description: The newest version of a name is the one used

domain.description: The folder it belongs to (defaults to its parent folder)

description.description: One paragraph: what this layout shows and for which entities

notes.description: Longer notes for authors and reviewers (plain text)

where.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row) that must be true for the Sutra to apply

priority.description: Higher wins when several Sutras match

with.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row): the counterparty or other entity named after the id

pill.description: The pill before the id (may hold ${…})

id.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row) for the id shown

strip.description: Up to eight fields in the header strip

bind.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

controls.description: Controls the reader sets: dropdowns, date ranges, search. Their values are read as ctl.<id> in expressions

options.description: A list of values or {value, label}, an expression over the record ($.legs[*].id), or {kind: <entity kind>}

default.description: A value, first, all, today, or a relative range such as next-90d

panel.description: The panel whose header holds the control (placement: header)

parent.description: The control a cascading control depends on

min.description: Lower bound of a number-range or slider: a number or an expression over the record

max.description: Upper bound of a number-range or slider

step.description: A slider's step: a number or an expression over the record (default 1)

range.description: A slider with two handles whose value is from..to (slider only)

F1.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F2.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F3.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F4.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F5.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F6.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F7.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F8.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F9.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F10.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F11.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

F12.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row), or impact or raw

keys.description: Function keys: link(…) to open an entity, impact (F8), raw (F9)

use.description: A use of a shared block: the block's panels, in its order, as if they were written here
A shared block (<name>.v<N>.block.yaml in a pack's sutras folder) as name@version: its panels go here

with.description: The block's parameters (its params:), each one value; the block's defaults otherwise

description.description: What the panel answers, for authors and reviewers

code.description: A short code at the heading's right (CRV, REFS)

span.description: Width in columns of a 12-column grid (default: the whole column)

height.description: Height in grid rows of 2.5rem (default: as tall as the content)

where.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row) that must be true for a row to be shown (it may read ctl.<id>)

on-select.description: A click on a row or bar sets a control: {filter: [panel ids], by: <control id>, field: <row field>}

panels.description: tabs only: panels shown inside each tab (kv, status, table, ladder, hbar, markdown, metric), read with @ as the tab's element

fields.description: The fields: { label, bind, fmt, tone }

rows.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

source.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

when.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

children.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

crumb.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

empty.description: The words shown when there are no rows (default: No data available)

expand.description: Levels of the tree shown open at first (default 1: only the top level); all opens every level

crumb.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row) naming a row of this level in the breadcrumb ('Flow ' + @.id)

title.description: What the rows of this level are (Cash flows)

rows.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row) giving the rows a row of the level above opens to, read with @ that row ("@.cashflows")

levels.description: Drill down level by level: a row opens to its rows of the next level, with a breadcrumb, the parent row, counts and totals at each level, and an address (#panel=1.6) that can be shared

limit.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

moreLabel.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

pivot.description: Offer a Pivot tab: true (by the panel's columns), or { fields, rows, columns, values, filters, heat, chart }

fields.description: The fields a user may pivot by: row paths, or { field, bind, label, fmt } (default: the panel's columns)

field.description: The field's name (a row path, or any name with a bind)

bind.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row) over the row (@), for a field that is not a plain path

rows.description: Fields down the side, outermost first

columns.description: Fields across the top, outermost first

values.description: The numbers in the cells: { field, agg, show }

agg.description: How a cell combines its rows (default sum)

show.description: As the value itself, or as a share of its row, column or the total

filters.description: Fields to filter by: names, or { field, values } / { field, min, max }

min.description: Lowest kept (a number or a date)

max.description: Highest kept (a number or a date)

heat.description: Shade each cell by its value

chart.description: Open with a chart of the result

totals.description: false hides subtotals and grand totals

root.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

each.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

tabTitle.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

mark.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

highlight.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

max.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

colors.description: gain-loss (default): rises green, falls red; theme: the theme's positive and negative colours (blue and orange, colour-blind friendly). Totals are neutral

bins.description: How many bins (default: the square root of the count, 5 to 40)

markers.description: Vertical marker lines: { label, value: <expression>, tone }

edges.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

nodes.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

agg.description: How the pivot combines the values of a cell (default sum)

by.description: The field the rows group by, or a list of fields for nested groups with subtotals (▸/▾)

heat.description: Colour each cell by its value

totals.description: false hides the row and column totals

caption.description: Small text under the figure (may hold ${…})

delta.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

deltaFmt.description: How the change is formatted (default: the format of value)

deltaTone.description: The change's tone: sign (default: positive green, negative red), status, or a fixed tone such as neg, warn or accent

region.description: Rachana-EL expression ($ is the document, @ the row)

shade.description: Shade each country by a field of every entity of a kind: { kind: economy, field: $.gdpUsdBn, by: $.iso3, fmt: amount0, label: GDP (USD bn) }. by defaults to $.iso3; the field is read as the caller may see it (a masked field shades nothing)
